evidence: The SiCl4 and H2O reactant exposures were 10 8-109 L. The H2O reactant exposures were 10 7-108 L. A SiCl4 exposure of 104 L removes nearly all of the isolated hydroxyl groups on the SiO2 surface. Larger SiCl4 exposures were used to react all the isolated hydroxyl groups and a fraction of the hydrogen-bonded hydroxyl groups.
